content: Hi, is anyone doing analytic philosophy in lean? I'd love to follow that work.

I'll share what Coherence Labs is doing: We are building a social platform where posts are Lean 4 code. The goal is to get people to start discussing ideas with formal logic. We've built an ontology (technically, a metaontology) layer on top of Lean. Our AI agent toolkit for translating everyday ideas into formal ontology is free: https://axiomreason.com/

hi @Sam Cymbaluk ! it's still very much a work in progress, but linglib now has a fair amount of formal logic as its been needed for formal semantics (which definitely blurs into analytic philosophy!)

Wow, really interesting stuff! Thanks for sharing, @Robert Hawkins! A lot of it is over my head, but I look forward to digging into it some more. I really like your "Why formalize linguistics?" write-up. You well articulated the benefits formalization unlocks (though, currently the "What's here" cards 404 error).
.

Pardon the potentially dumb question: Is it a goal to eventually be able to provide an English sentence and have it mapped to (a) formal interpretation(s)?. I asked Fable to formalize the sentence "I had a muffin for breakfast, but I would've felt better if I had eaten eggs instead." But I lack the expertise to tell how well it did: https://gist.github.com/SemanticSamuel/6b66ff4931f38162d2e99ea7e6997256
